title: Ambient exceptional adjoint by composition of compactification factors
statement: Let X and Y be schemes, f : X → Y a morphism admitting a compactification, and Λ a finite commutative ring. The functor Rf_! on ordinary unbounded derived categories of étale Λ-module sheaves is a left adjoint. Here Rf_! is exactly the source-library functor D(i_!) ⋙ Rg_* for the chosen compactification (i,g).

proof.text: Let c be HasCompactification.compactification f. The source-library openImmersionLowerShriekAdjunction gives i_! ⊣ restriction. The exactness instances for i_! and the existing mapDerivedCategoryRightDerivedAdjunction give D(i_!) ⊣ R(restriction); hence D(i_!) is a left adjoint. These are direct applications of existing library declarations, without any new geometric input.
The proper morphism c.g has a derived direct image that is a left adjoint by lem-etale-proper-derived-direct-image-adjoint.
Unfold the chosen-compactification definition of Rf_!. It is D(i_!) ⋙ Rg_*. Functor.isLeftAdjoint_comp combines the two left-adjoint instances, proving the original instance unchanged.
